malicious.instructions: Is this timeline entry evidence of attacker activity on the host?

criteria.true: Attacker tooling, intrusion, persistence, credential theft, tampering or data theft
criteria.false: Normal operating system, application, update or user activity

category.instructions: What kind of activity does this entry record?

criteria.execution: A program, script or command being run
criteria.persistence: Something arranged to survive reboot or logoff
criteria.credential_access: Password, hash, ticket or token theft
criteria.defense_evasion: Clearing logs, disabling protection, hiding files
criteria.benign_system: Routine OS, driver or update activity

severity.instructions: If this is attacker activity, how serious is it?

needs_analyst.instructions: Does a human analyst need to look at this entry personally?
